objective.text: Verify both console output and exit status instead of treating printed success text as a successful command result.

difficulty.rationale: Verify operational success independently of a printed message.

runtime.sapi: Isolated CLI Laravel harness unless another context is explicitly stated
runtime.errorPolicy: E_ALL; UTC; no external services or application data

stem: A command prints "Imported" but returns exit code 1 after detecting an incomplete import. A regression test currently checks only that text. What should it also verify for a successful-import case?

options.text: The command produces no stderr text.
options.rationale: A command can return a failure exit code without writing to stderr.
options.misconception: A command can return a failure exit code without writing to stderr.

options.text: The output contains no line beginning with Error.
options.rationale: An unsuccessful command can use different wording or report failure only through its exit code.
options.misconception: An unsuccessful command can use different wording or report failure only through its exit code.

options.text: The command exits successfully, in addition to printing the expected output.
options.rationale: Printed text and process success are independent; checking both catches the stated contradiction.
Repeating the text check still does not inspect the exit status.
options.misconception: Repeating the text check still does not inspect the exit status.
